metadata.note: Bộ 40 câu hỏi kiểm thử Text-to-SQL cho DACS4 theo chuẩn Spider/BIRD (easy, medium, hard, edge).

questions.question: Có bao nhiêu đơn hàng trong toàn bộ hệ thống?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM fact_orders

questions.question: Tổng doanh thu bán hàng (tính theo cột price) là bao nhiêu?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM fact_orders

questions.question: Điểm đánh giá trung bình của toàn bộ đơn hàng là bao nhiêu?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM fact_orders WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM fact_orders

questions.question: Thời gian giao hàng trung bình (tính theo ngày) là bao nhiêu?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders WHERE delivery_days IS NOT NULL
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders

questions.question: Có bao nhiêu đơn hàng đã giao thành công (trạng thái delivered)?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM fact_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

questions.question: Có bao nhiêu đơn hàng bị hủy (trạng thái canceled)?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS canceled_orders FROM fact_orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

questions.question: Tổng chi phí vận chuyển (freight_value) của tất cả đơn hàng là bao nhiêu?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(freight_value), 2) AS total_freight FROM fact_orders

questions.question: Giá sản phẩm cao nhất và thấp nhất (theo cột price) trong fact_orders là bao nhiêu?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(price), 2) AS max_price, ROUND(MIN(price), 2) AS min_price FROM fact_orders

questions.question: Hệ thống có bao nhiêu sản phẩm trong bảng dim_products?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM dim_products
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS total_products FROM dim_products

questions.question: Có bao nhiêu người bán trong bảng dim_sellers?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sellers FROM dim_sellers
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS total_sellers FROM dim_sellers

questions.question: Có bao nhiêu khách hàng duy nhất (customer_unique_id) trong dim_customers?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM dim_customers

questions.question: Có bao nhiêu đơn hàng thanh toán bằng thẻ tín dụng (credit_card)?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS cc_orders FROM fact_orders WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

questions.question: Top 10 danh mục sản phẩm có doanh thu (theo price) cao nhất?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name_english AS category, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE p.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name_english ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name_english AS category, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.product_category_name_english ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Doanh thu (theo price) theo từng tháng trong năm 2017, sắp xếp theo thứ tự tháng?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.month, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2017 GROUP BY d.month ORDER BY d.month

questions.question: Số lượng đơn hàng theo từng năm, sắp xếp tăng dần theo năm?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.year, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year ASC

questions.question: Top 5 bang của khách hàng có nhiều đơn hàng nhất?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS total_orders FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_customers c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Top 5 bang của người bán có tổng doanh thu (theo price) cao nhất?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_sellers s ON f.seller_key = s.seller_key GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Điểm đánh giá trung bình theo từng phương thức thanh toán (bỏ qua giá trị NULL)?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM fact_orders WHERE payment_type IS NOT NULL AND review_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_type
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM fact_orders WHERE payment_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_type

questions.question: Doanh thu (theo price) theo từng quý trong năm 2018, sắp xếp theo quý?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.quarter, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2018 GROUP BY d.quarter ORDER BY d.quarter

questions.question: So sánh số lượng đơn hàng đặt vào ngày cuối tuần (is_weekend = true) và ngày thường (is_weekend = false)?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.is_weekend, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.is_weekend

questions.question: Top 5 thành phố của khách hàng có số lượng khách hàng nhiều nhất?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM dim_customers GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_city, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count FROM dim_customers GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.customer_city, COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_key) AS customer_count FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_customers c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Top 5 bang của khách hàng có thời gian giao hàng trung bình lâu nhất?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(f.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_customers c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key WHERE f.delivery_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC LIMIT 5
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(f.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_customers c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Số lượng đơn hàng theo từng trạng thái đơn hàng (order_status), sắp xếp giảm dần?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM fact_orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC

questions.question: Top 5 danh mục sản phẩm có số lượng dòng sản phẩm bán ra nhiều nhất?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE p.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name_english ORDER BY item_count DESC LIMIT 5
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.product_category_name_english ORDER BY item_count DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Tính doanh thu (theo price) theo từng tháng năm 2017 và tỉ lệ tăng trưởng (%) so với tháng trước?
questions.ground_truth_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT d.month, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2017 GROUP BY d.month) SELECT month, revenue, ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM monthly ORDER BY month

questions.question: Tỉ lệ phần trăm số đơn hàng theo từng phương thức thanh toán (bỏ qua payment_type NULL), sắp xếp giảm dần?
questions.ground_truth_sql: WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM fact_orders WHERE payment_type IS NOT NULL) SELECT f.payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) * 100.0 / t.total_orders, 2) AS percentage FROM fact_orders f CROSS JOIN total t WHERE f.payment_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.payment_type, t.total_orders ORDER BY order_count DESC
alt_ground_truth_sql: WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM fact_orders) SELECT f.payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) * 100.0 / t.total_orders, 2) AS percentage FROM fact_orders f CROSS JOIN total t WHERE f.payment_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.payment_type, t.total_orders ORDER BY order_count DESC

questions.question: Top 5 danh mục sản phẩm có thời gian giao hàng trung bình cao nhất trong số các danh mục có hơn 500 đơn hàng?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name_english AS category, ROUND(AVG(f.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE f.delivery_days IS NOT NULL AND p.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name_english HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) > 500 ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC LIMIT 5
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_category_name_english AS category, ROUND(AVG(f.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_key = p.product_key WHERE p.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category_name_english HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) > 500 ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Doanh thu tích lũy (running total theo price) theo từng tháng trong năm 2018?
questions.ground_truth_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT d.month, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS monthly_revenue FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2018 GROUP BY d.month) SELECT month, monthly_revenue, ROUND(SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_revenue FROM monthly ORDER BY month

questions.question: Top 5 khách hàng (customer_unique_id) có tổng chi tiêu (theo price) cao nhất kèm số đơn hàng của họ?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS total_spend, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_customers c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Có bao nhiêu khách hàng (theo customer_unique_id) đã mua từ 2 đơn hàng trở lên (khách quay lại)?
questions.ground_truth_sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_customers c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) >= 2) SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM customer_orders

questions.question: Những bang nào của khách hàng có thời gian giao hàng trung bình lớn hơn thời gian giao hàng trung bình của toàn hệ thống?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(f.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_customers c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key WHERE f.delivery_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state HAVING AVG(f.delivery_days) > (SELECT AVG(delivery_days) FROM fact_orders WHERE delivery_days IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC

questions.question: Tìm danh mục sản phẩm có doanh thu (theo price) cao nhất trong mỗi năm (2016, 2017, 2018)?
questions.ground_truth_sql: WITH yearly_cat AS (SELECT d.year, p.product_category_name_english AS category, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.year ORDER BY SUM(f.price) DESC) AS rn FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_key = p.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year IN (2016, 2017, 2018) AND p.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.year, p.product_category_name_english) SELECT year, category, revenue FROM yearly_cat WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY year
alt_ground_truth_sql: WITH yearly_cat AS (SELECT d.year, p.product_category_name_english AS category, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.year ORDER BY SUM(f.price) DESC) AS rn FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_products p ON f.product_key = p.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE p.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.year, p.product_category_name_english) SELECT year, category, revenue FROM yearly_cat WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY year

questions.question: So sánh số lượng đơn hàng và thời gian giao hàng trung bình giữa đơn hàng nội bang (customer_state = seller_state) và đơn hàng liên bang (customer_state != seller_state)?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.customer_state = s.seller_state THEN 'Nội bang' ELSE 'Liên bang' END AS scope, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(f.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_customers c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key JOIN dim_sellers s ON f.seller_key = s.seller_key WHERE f.delivery_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scope
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.customer_state = s.seller_state THEN 'same_state' ELSE 'cross_state' END AS scope, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(f.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_customers c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key JOIN dim_sellers s ON f.seller_key = s.seller_key GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Top 5 người bán (seller_id) có doanh thu (theo price) cao nhất kèm điểm đánh giá trung bình, chỉ xét người bán có ít nhất 100 đơn hàng?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(f.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_sellers s ON f.seller_key = s.seller_key WHERE f.review_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) >= 100 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5
alt_ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(f.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_sellers s ON f.seller_key = s.seller_key GROUP BY s.seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) >= 100 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Top 5 thành phố thuộc bang SP có doanh thu (theo price) cao nhất trong năm 2018?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_city, ROUND(SUM(f.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM fact_orders f JOIN dim_customers c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP' AND d.year = 2018 GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5
